# JPlant Advertising

> Performance advertising agency in Phoenix, Arizona, founded by Jonathan Plant. Runs Facebook and Instagram (Meta) ads that sell event tickets (concerts, festivals, club nights, college events) and grow businesses that sell online, by lead or by booking. All-time blended return on ad spend 6.79X; $350K+ in revenue for clients. Clients have included Desert Events, Bar Crawling, Thank You For Dancing, Crowd Control and Thaw Out Festival, with events featuring Insomniac and Rolling Loud.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://jplantadvertising.com/): services, results and the founder
- [Meta ads for events](https://jplantadvertising.com/meta-ads-for-events/): how we sell tickets, with FAQ
- [Event ad benchmarks](https://jplantadvertising.com/event-ad-benchmarks/): original data from 26 event campaigns. Median 9.63X return on ad spend, $3.36 ad cost per order, $0.28 per click
- [Event ad budget calculator](https://jplantadvertising.com/tools/event-ad-budget-calculator/): free tool, how much to spend on ads to sell a ticket goal
- [Phoenix Meta ads agency](https://jplantadvertising.com/phoenix-meta-ads-agency/)

## Facts
- Founder: Jonathan Plant. Started the agency in college selling tickets for one event.
- Location: Phoenix, Arizona, USA. Serves clients nationwide.
